interpretation: Original source mapping only. mapped-not-enabled never implies a linkable provider, adapter support, or guest-visible success.

service_families.host_binding: DemDispatch and handlers include softpc.h and use historical register/SAS contracts.
CmdDispatch and handlers include softpc.h; command, console, process, and environment services need CLI capability review.
XMSDispatch and handlers include softpc.h; A20/extended-memory/UMB semantics require native-machine ownership review.
DpmiDispatch reads the subfunction via Sim32GetVDMPointer and advances IP under protected-mode state.
VrDispatch includes NT/Win32, network, named-pipe, mailslot, NetAPI and DLC bindings.
DBGDispatch reads VDM stack frames via Sim32GetVDMPointer; its source does not expose an equivalent flat function-pointer table.

debugger.host_binding: DBGDispatch reads VDM stack frames via Sim32GetVDMPointer; its source does not expose an equivalent flat function-pointer table.

softpc_bios.interpretation: Historical BIOS[] owner symbols are retained verbatim from the input inventory; no conditional row is asserted active.
